status: Authored domain design; no production packs, automatic verifiers or VM provisioning are installed by this artifact.

domain.title: Infrastructure & Internet Operations
domain.description: Practical Linux, virtualization, hosting, private access, delivery, mail, performance and resilient operations.

learner_entry.beginner: Start at track 1; short explanation, worked operation, changed-condition repair, then an independent build.
learner_entry.practitioner: Use optional practical capability checks or directly select a matching independent task; no compulsory beginner tour.
learner_entry.intent: Job preparation and interest-led learning share technical evidence; portfolio/handover emphasis and exploration choices differ.
learner_entry.credit: Shared DevOps capabilities require explicit evidence/receipt bindings; presentation links alone neither complete nodes nor duplicate XP.
learner_entry.bootstrap: Before track 1, provide an ungraded, host-specific guide to a supported prepared Linux guest or existing owned/assigned Linux environment. Teach file paths, terminal/console access and the machine boundary. Full host administration is learned in track 2; setup time is tracked separately.

estimates.basis: Author estimates of active learning and practice, not measured completion times; exclude hardware acquisition, provider approval, large downloads and unusual remediation.
estimates.initial_support: Local Linux is the first intended execution target; other architectures and hosts need recipe-level replay before a tested badge.

small_server.storage: microSD; usable free space and endurance are separate constraints

learner_pc.cpu_description: approximately 16 cores as supplied; inspect actual topology

shared_runner.status: Prior authorization retained. This domain's guest VMs, arbitrary build work and public services are learner-owned; new hosted adapters still require review and measurements.

lesson_contract: observe named positive and negative controls
record artifacts, save location and evidence scope

tracks.title: Linux & Network Foundations
tracks.outcome: Explain a request path and operate a small Linux service using observations.
tracks.environment: Local processes first; one disposable Linux VM for services and networking.

levels.title: Follow a real request
levels.concepts: Processes, sockets, client/server, addresses and ports.
levels.guided_lab: Run the supplied service, call it with curl, and correlate one request with its process and log.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a wrong port and a stopped process from a changed fixture.
levels.milestone_evidence: Record the address, listening process, response and the observation that distinguishes each failure.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Own files, processes and permissions
levels.concepts: Shell command structure, quoting, variables, pipes/redirection, stdout/stderr, paths, users/groups, environment, exit codes and signals.
levels.guided_lab: Trace command output and errors, then run the service as an unprivileged user and inspect its working directory and open files.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a permission or environment fault without broadening unrelated access.
levels.milestone_evidence: The legitimate service works; another lab user still cannot read its synthetic secret.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Connect a local network
levels.concepts: Subnets, DHCP, ARP/neighbor discovery, routes, loopback and bind addresses.
levels.guided_lab: Connect a client and server using a disposable virtual network; then try a second owned device if available.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Find a wrong subnet, guest-Wi-Fi isolation or loopback-only binding.
levels.milestone_evidence: A route/interface map and both successful and deliberately blocked probes explain the result.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Resolve names deliberately
levels.concepts: Stub/recursive/authoritative DNS, records, TTL, cache and split DNS.
levels.guided_lab: Use an isolated DNS fixture and inspect answers, authority and caching with dig.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a stale or wrong answer while distinguishing hosts-file substitution from DNS.
levels.milestone_evidence: The correct authority and address are observed; bypassing DNS is identified as a diagnostic only.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Read transport and application failures
levels.concepts: TCP, UDP, HTTP, TLS, connections, timeouts and certificate names.
levels.guided_lab: Compare connection refusal, timeout, HTTP error and certificate rejection on owned endpoints.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Locate a failing layer from a fresh set of observations.
levels.milestone_evidence: Explain why ping or a successful TCP connection alone does not prove a working website.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Cross network boundaries
levels.concepts: NAT, forwarding, CGNAT, IPv4/IPv6, firewall paths and hairpin access.
levels.guided_lab: Model an inner and outer network with VMs or namespaces; compare address and route observations.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Choose a viable inbound or outbound-relay path when the origin lacks a reachable address.
levels.milestone_evidence: Identify every required routing/firewall/relay authority; a virtual outer network is labelled simulated WAN.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Keep a service running
levels.concepts: Package repositories, updates, service installation, systemd, boot, users, health/readiness and durable state.
levels.guided_lab: Create a service unit in a disposable guest and test restart and guest reboot.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a restart loop caused by a bad path or configuration.
levels.milestone_evidence: Correct version and state survive reboot; invalid configuration remains observable.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Recover your first service
levels.concepts: Diagnosis, evidence, least-change repair and handover.
levels.guided_lab: Follow a worked service outage, then build a small request-path runbook.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a fresh fault involving two of DNS, process, binding or permissions.
levels.milestone_evidence: A fresh client reproduces the working result and the negative access control still holds.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Virtual Machines & Host Administration
tracks.outcome: Create, host, resize, recover and administer guest machines from an owned hypervisor.
tracks.environment: Linux KVM/QEMU with libvirt; VM/WSL/other-host alternatives require their stated virtualization support.

levels.title: Understand the host and guest
levels.concepts: Hardware virtualization, hypervisor, guest kernel, emulation, containers and nested virtualization.
levels.guided_lab: Inventory CPU architecture, virtualization support and available memory/storage; select a supported hypervisor route.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain a machine where SSH works but no desktop VM application is visible.
levels.milestone_evidence: Identify the host control plane and guest boundary; SSH alone is not used to identify a vendor.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Create a machine from a known image
levels.concepts: Cloud images, checksums, virtual disks, firmware, cloud-init and console access.
levels.guided_lab: Create a guest with a unique name, key and network identity using libvirt tooling.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover failed first boot or an incorrect cloud-init setup using the guest console.
levels.milestone_evidence: The guest boots, reports the expected image, and is accessible through the intended identity.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Build virtual networks
levels.concepts: NAT, bridge, routed networks, virtual switches, DHCP and host/guest firewalls.
levels.guided_lab: Connect a service guest and a client guest; compare NAT and a supported bridged/routed setup.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Fix an unreachable SSH or HTTP service without exposing every guest port.
levels.milestone_evidence: Record host, guest and outer-network probes; Wi-Fi bridge limitations are acknowledged.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Administer through SSH and console
levels.concepts: Host authority, guest sudo, host keys, key-based access, jump hosts and rescue console.
levels.guided_lab: Reach a private guest through a bastion and use host tools to inspect its lifecycle.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a guest SSH lockout through the owned console.
levels.milestone_evidence: Guest access and hypervisor administration use distinct credentials and permissions.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Host websites inside guests
levels.concepts: Guest process, private address, edge proxy, TLS and public-routing boundaries.
levels.guided_lab: Run Relay inside a VM and route a host/edge URL to its private service address.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a working guest service that the edge cannot reach.
levels.milestone_evidence: Versioned HTTP evidence follows client → edge → guest; direct access policy is tested separately.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Change CPU, memory and storage
levels.concepts: Configured/current resources, quotas, balloon/hotplug support, virtual disk versus filesystem.
levels.guided_lab: Resize an owned guest using a supported shutdown or live procedure, then grow its partition/filesystem where required.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain a larger virtual disk that has not increased filesystem space.
levels.milestone_evidence: Host and guest observations agree; data remains intact; unsupported hot changes are not faked.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Clone and recover machines
levels.concepts: Templates, unique identities, snapshots, image chains, independent backup and restore.
levels.guided_lab: Create two guests from a template and restore one from a separately retained backup.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Find a duplicated identity or a snapshot dependent on a missing parent image.
levels.milestone_evidence: Fresh guests have unique identities; restored data works without the original active disk.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Operate a small guest fleet
levels.concepts: Inventory, lifecycle, resource limits, autostart, failed jobs and console recovery.
levels.guided_lab: Manage a service guest, client guest and optional utility guest through virsh or an existing management UI.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Handle a failed start or exhausted lab allocation while protecting host headroom.
levels.milestone_evidence: Inventory matches reality; only owned guests change; guest website and recovery checks pass.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Web Hosting & Public Deployment
tracks.outcome: Publish an appropriate service and explain its DNS, transport, cost and availability dependencies.
tracks.environment: Local Linux/VM plus optional learner-selected external hostname/account/network.

levels.title: Choose the hosting model
levels.concepts: Static assets, dynamic requests, build output, runtime, state and platform contracts.
levels.guided_lab: Publish a static build locally and run a dynamic service; compare what each requires.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Choose a deployment target for a site that needs server-side processing.
levels.milestone_evidence: A static host is not claimed to execute an unsupported server or persist runtime data.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Put an edge in front
levels.concepts: Reverse proxy, upstream address, headers, TLS termination, trust and names.
levels.guided_lab: Run the real local Caddy lab and inspect the generated route and certificate controls.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Fix a changed upstream/name mismatch while preserving the intended boundary.
levels.milestone_evidence: Correct HTTP/TLS controls pass; wrong upstream, trust and name controls fail for the expected reasons.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Own a name and certificate
levels.concepts: DNS delegation, A/AAAA/CNAME, TTL, ACME, HTTP/DNS challenges and renewal.
levels.guided_lab: Use local DNS/TLS fixtures, then a supported public hostname/certificate variant when available.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a bad AAAA, stale answer or renewal prerequisite.
levels.milestone_evidence: Public claims include an external lookup and verification; locally trusted certificates remain labelled local.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Serve from home or a VPS
levels.concepts: Public/private addresses, router forwarding, CGNAT, IPv6, DNS and continuous operation.
levels.guided_lab: Deploy to a guest/spare machine and test an owned external client path or simulated outer network.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Select a workable route when router control or public inbound access is unavailable.
levels.milestone_evidence: Record each boundary, who controls it, and whether outside-internet reachability was actually tested.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Publish a free static site
levels.concepts: Build pipelines, provider subdomains, repository visibility, paths and usage limits.
levels.guided_lab: Deploy synthetic public content through a current eligible free static route such as GitHub Pages.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Fix an asset/base-path or build-output failure.
levels.milestone_evidence: The published URL serves the expected build; account, visibility and provider limits are recorded.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Try free dynamic hosting
levels.concepts: Execution compatibility, quotas, cold starts, runtime storage and database lifetime.
levels.guided_lab: Deploy a compatible small endpoint on a current free offering; keep an equivalent local route.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a sleeping service or disappearing local runtime data.
levels.milestone_evidence: Cold-start and persistence behaviour are observed; free-tier constraints are stated with date.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Publish through cloudflared
levels.concepts: Outbound connector, Quick versus named tunnels, public HTTP routes, Access and restart.
levels.guided_lab: Compare a temporary Quick Tunnel with a named route when the learner has the required account/domain.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a wrong origin route or blocked connector transport; restrict a private application.
levels.milestone_evidence: The URL, authentication policy and origin lifetime are independently checked; a tunnel is not treated as hosting.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Diagnose a public deployment
levels.concepts: LAN versus external clients, certificate/DNS state, origin availability and revocation.
levels.guided_lab: Maintain a deployment record and test a second owned network when available.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a mixed DNS/origin/access failure and remove the intended public route.
levels.milestone_evidence: Evidence distinguishes LAN, simulated WAN and real internet; cleanup and retained work are explicit.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Private Networks, SSH & Tunnels
tracks.outcome: Choose, configure and diagnose private access and tunnels with clear trust and routing boundaries.
tracks.environment: Two local guests or network namespaces; optional phone, Pi, router or reachable relay.

levels.title: Establish remote identity
levels.concepts: SSH host verification, user keys, agents, revocation and least privilege.
levels.guided_lab: Create distinct lab identities and verify the remote host before logging in.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Replace a revoked key while preserving legitimate access and console recovery.
levels.milestone_evidence: Wrong host identity and revoked credentials are rejected for the intended reasons.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Forward a local service
levels.concepts: SSH -L, listener binding, destination perspective and access restrictions.
levels.guided_lab: Reach a private guest service through an authenticated local forward.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Correct a destination resolved on the wrong side of the SSH connection.
levels.milestone_evidence: Only the intended local listener and destination are available; closing SSH removes the forward.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Reverse and dynamically forward
levels.concepts: SSH -R/-D, SOCKS, GatewayPorts, relay reachability and connection lifetime.
levels.guided_lab: Build loopback-bound reverse forwarding and a separate SOCKS experiment on owned guests.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a CGNAT origin whose relay or listener is unreachable.
levels.milestone_evidence: Direction and binding are explained; a public reverse route requires a reachable, authorized relay.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Build a WireGuard network
levels.concepts: Keys, peers, UDP, routes, AllowedIPs, forwarding and MTU.
levels.guided_lab: Connect two guests, then optionally a phone or Pi; test only the chosen routes.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a bad AllowedIPs/route/MTU fixture and revoke one peer.
levels.milestone_evidence: Intended traffic passes; an unlisted route or revoked peer fails without breaking the legitimate path.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Compare managed and self-hosted coordination
levels.concepts: Tailscale, Headscale, coordination, direct data paths, NAT traversal and relays.
levels.guided_lab: Join a supported managed lab network or an owned Headscale lab; inspect actual connection paths.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain relay use and an offline peer without assuming every connection is direct.
levels.milestone_evidence: Document account/control-plane dependencies, peer access and the measured path.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Use subnet and exit nodes
levels.concepts: Subnet routing, internet egress, split DNS, forwarding and route approval.
levels.guided_lab: Expose one private lab subnet, then separately test a scoped exit-node exercise.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Fix a DNS/route conflict or unintended egress path.
levels.milestone_evidence: Private-subnet access and internet egress are demonstrated as different capabilities.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Reach private services through Cloudflare
levels.concepts: Public HTTP versus client-assisted TCP/SSH and private network access.
levels.guided_lab: Compare a public browser route with the documented client-assisted private access path.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a missing client, denied identity or unavailable outbound transport.
levels.milestone_evidence: Protocol, client and identity requirements are explicit; normal HTTP Tunnel is not presented as public SMTP.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Build and compare a custom relay
levels.concepts: SSH versus frp/rathole, authentication, framing, flow control, reconnects and allowlisted targets.
levels.guided_lab: Configure an owned self-hosted relay; optionally implement a bounded educational relay over standard TLS.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Test disconnect, denied target and oversized-frame cases against the supplied lab contract.
levels.milestone_evidence: A reachable relay and approved targets are required; handwritten crypto and an unaudited public open proxy are excluded.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Delivery & Infrastructure Automation
tracks.outcome: Reproduce a service and its infrastructure, promote a tested release, and recover a bad change.
tracks.environment: Local Linux guests and source repository; optional learner-owned CI/registry account.

levels.title: Build an identifiable release
levels.concepts: Git, dependency inputs, tests, artifact checksums and configuration.
levels.guided_lab: Build Relay from a known revision and retain a manifest.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Detect a runtime that differs from the tested artifact.
levels.milestone_evidence: Source, tests and deployed artifact identity form one traceable release record.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Package the runtime
levels.concepts: Containers versus VMs, images, layers, users, networks and volumes.
levels.guided_lab: Run an immutable image locally and in the service VM.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a recreation that lost data or changed runtime identity.
levels.milestone_evidence: State and version controls pass; building a container is not confused with provisioning a VM.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Compose a small service
levels.concepts: Compose, dependencies, readiness, secrets, logs and owned cleanup.
levels.guided_lab: Run edge, application and state components with explicit data locations.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a dependency-order or configuration failure.
levels.milestone_evidence: All components become ready; only the lab's resources are removed during cleanup.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Automate checks in CI
levels.concepts: Triggers, runner identity, permissions, caches, artifacts and secret boundaries.
levels.guided_lab: Run a failing and passing change in a learner-owned CI project or equivalent local pipeline rehearsal.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Prevent an untrusted or failing change from accessing deployment credentials.
levels.milestone_evidence: Actual CI receipts and local rehearsal reports are labelled separately.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Promote and roll back
levels.concepts: Staging, immutable promotion, release gates, concurrent releases and data compatibility.
levels.guided_lab: Promote one tested artifact and recover a seeded stateless regression.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain why code rollback cannot undo an incompatible database change.
levels.milestone_evidence: Version and user-behaviour checks pass; retained state matches the task's contract.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Declare infrastructure
levels.concepts: OpenTofu/provider boundary, plan/apply, state, drift and destruction.
levels.guided_lab: Provision owned local VM resources with a reviewed provider and inspect its state.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Reject or correct a plan that replaces the wrong resource.
levels.milestone_evidence: Plan, applied inventory and teardown agree; state containing secrets is not publicly submitted.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Configure a fleet
levels.concepts: Ansible inventory, idempotence, privilege scope, secret handling and change limits.
levels.guided_lab: Configure two owned guests and run the same playbook again.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair drift without altering a guest outside the inventory.
levels.milestone_evidence: The second run has the intended idempotent result and unrelated guests remain unchanged.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Recreate and recover the delivery path
levels.concepts: Automation, release evidence, infrastructure ownership and runbooks.
levels.guided_lab: Rebuild a clean target and deploy the same release using the recorded procedure.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a failed deployment or expired synthetic credential.
levels.milestone_evidence: Another clean environment can reproduce the result; all residual owned resources are accounted for.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Mail & Stateful Self-Hosting
tracks.outcome: Operate a local mail system and stateful service, and assess the extra requirements for reliable public mail.
tracks.environment: Isolated Linux guests/containers using synthetic mail; public-mail variant has separate domain/IP/provider requirements.

levels.title: Follow a message
levels.concepts: Application submission, SMTP envelope, headers, queues and delivery versus receipt.
levels.guided_lab: Send synthetic application mail to local Mailpit and inspect its envelope and content.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Find a wrong recipient/envelope or application configuration.
levels.milestone_evidence: Mail capture is demonstrated without claiming an internet mail server or external delivery.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Run SMTP between owned hosts
levels.concepts: Postfix, domains, relaying policy, ports, queues and rejection.
levels.guided_lab: Deliver synthetic messages between isolated lab MTAs using reserved test domains.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Reject unauthorized relay while preserving legitimate lab delivery.
levels.milestone_evidence: Accepted, queued, delivered and rejected messages have the correct evidence.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Provide authenticated mailbox access
levels.concepts: Dovecot/IMAP, submission, TLS, credentials, mailbox storage and service roles.
levels.guided_lab: Read an owned mailbox and submit through the intended authenticated endpoint.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Reject a wrong name, credential or unauthenticated relay attempt.
levels.milestone_evidence: Submission and mailbox access work independently; port roles and TLS controls are correct.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Authenticate sender domains
levels.concepts: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, alignment, signing and verification.
levels.guided_lab: Use local DNS/message fixtures and real signing/verification on synthetic messages.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Detect a bad signature or misaligned identity without treating SPF as encryption.
levels.milestone_evidence: The learner explains and observes each check; local DNS fixtures do not assert public delegation.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Assess a public mail deployment
levels.concepts: Domain control, reachable IP, PTR authority, port policy, reputation and provider terms.
levels.guided_lab: Inspect an eligible learner environment and build a go/no-go record; use a full local equivalent otherwise.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Identify blocked SMTP or an unavailable PTR change before claiming deployability.
levels.milestone_evidence: Public requirements are substantiated; an HTTP tunnel or free software alone is not accepted.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Operate queues and delivery
levels.concepts: Retries, bounces, throttling, blocklists, reputation, relay options and monitoring.
levels.guided_lab: Diagnose synthetic queued/bounced mail; perform the public variant only with owned consenting endpoints.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a stalled queue or a rejected delivery with the correct cause.
levels.milestone_evidence: Local transport and real external deliverability have separate evidence and limits.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Keep state consistent
levels.concepts: SQLite/PostgreSQL roles, transactions, one-writer limits, mail storage and backup consistency.
levels.guided_lab: Back up the sample application/mail state and restore into a clean target.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Detect an inconsistent backup or a multi-writer design that exceeds its database guarantees.
levels.milestone_evidence: Restored records and messages are checked; a shared disk or copied WAL is not called replicated HA.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Recover a mail service
levels.concepts: Secrets, independent restore, relay controls, retained data and operating cost.
levels.guided_lab: Recover the local mail service from a fresh failure and document any public-service dependencies.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Rotate credentials and reject relay after restoration while legitimate delivery continues.
levels.milestone_evidence: The runbook reproduces data and access controls; public-mail readiness stays separately labelled.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Traffic, Concurrency & Capacity
tracks.outcome: Measure a workload, identify bottlenecks, protect service boundaries and justify a deployment size.
tracks.environment: Bounded load against owned local services; larger load or external targets require their own declared budget.

levels.title: Define the workload
levels.concepts: Requests, users, arrival rate, concurrency, response sizes, latency distributions and SLOs.
levels.guided_lab: Record a baseline workload with a fixed dataset and clear measurement boundaries.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Reject a misleading average or a claimed user capacity without a workload.
levels.milestone_evidence: Success/error/latency measures include units, time window, workload and client placement.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Balance service traffic
levels.concepts: Caddy/HAProxy/NGINX, balancing algorithms, active/passive checks, readiness and draining.
levels.guided_lab: Run two service instances behind an explicitly configured balancer.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Remove a ready target from new traffic while an existing request finishes.
levels.milestone_evidence: Distribution, failed-target handling and recovery are observed; the edge remains a single failure point.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Manage state across replicas
levels.concepts: Sessions, shared state, sticky routing, streaming, WebSockets and retryable writes.
levels.guided_lab: Compare stateless version requests with a stateful operation through two instances.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a lost session or duplicated write during node changes.
levels.milestone_evidence: State/idempotency controls hold; stickiness is not presented as a replacement for data design.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Choose concurrency deliberately
levels.concepts: I/O versus CPU work, threads, processes, async tasks, worker memory and pools.
levels.guided_lab: Compare a bounded I/O fixture with a CPU-bound fixture inside the declared lab allocation.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Find why adding workers increases latency or memory without improving useful work.
levels.milestone_evidence: The chosen worker model is supported by measurements and a resource boundary.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Apply backpressure
levels.concepts: Bounded queues, semaphores, timeouts, pool limits, retries, cancellation and fairness.
levels.guided_lab: Run a controlled overload with explicit admission limits and recovery.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair retry amplification or queue growth using changed constraints.
levels.milestone_evidence: Rejected, timed-out and completed work are all counted; admitted work and queue memory stay bounded.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Generate meaningful load
levels.concepts: k6 open/closed models, coordinated omission, dropped iterations, warmup and generator limits.
levels.guided_lab: Run short capped tests against owned targets using both workload models.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain a test that lowers offered load as the server slows.
levels.milestone_evidence: Actual offered load, successful throughput, errors and dropped work accompany latency.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Estimate resources
levels.concepts: CPU service time, memory working sets, disk capacity/IOPS, bandwidth and Little's Law.
levels.guided_lab: Build a sizing worksheet from measured components, reserves and an explicit workload.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Find a limit caused by uplink, disk or pool size despite spare CPU.
levels.milestone_evidence: Predictions state units and assumptions, then are compared with a bounded validation run.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Optimize and verify
levels.concepts: Profiles, indexing, caching, batching, compression, limits and cost tradeoffs.
levels.guided_lab: Change one bottleneck, rerun the same workload and retain the before/after record.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Reject an apparent gain caused by changed error accounting or an easier workload.
levels.milestone_evidence: Improvement preserves correctness and target SLOs; no universal users-per-GB claim is made.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Resilient Operations & Efficient Hardware
tracks.outcome: Operate within a small machine's limits, recover data and migrate the same service as resources improve.
tracks.environment: Small guest/resource profile on a PC; optional Pi, spare PC, SSD, second backup device and power equipment.

levels.title: Keep an owned service available
levels.concepts: Boot, restart, time synchronization, readiness, monitoring location and failure domains.
levels.guided_lab: Reboot a disposable service guest and verify version, state and startup.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose a service that works only while the terminal is open.
levels.milestone_evidence: Recovery is observed; same-host monitoring is not treated as proof that a powered-off host can alert.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Bound operational data
levels.concepts: Log rotation, journal quotas, metrics cardinality, retention and disk headroom.
levels.guided_lab: Set per-lab log/metrics limits and inspect their effects on a generated small dataset.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Fix unbounded growth without deleting the entire machine's logs or masking errors.
levels.milestone_evidence: Retention and available-space controls are measured; compaction and temporary storage have room.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Restore independent data
levels.concepts: Backup consistency, independent copies, restore drills, RPO/RTO and retention.
levels.guided_lab: Restore into a clean guest from a separately retained copy.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover from a lost active disk and check required records against stated objectives.
levels.milestone_evidence: Observed data loss and recovery time are reported; a same-disk snapshot is labelled dependent.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Operate on microSD
levels.concepts: Write volume, flash endurance, swap pressure, tmpfs, durable state and SSD migration.
levels.guided_lab: Use a bounded VM profile to compare logging/write policies; repeat selected observations on a Pi if available.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a full lab data volume and choose what may safely be ephemeral.
levels.milestone_evidence: Durable data survives; reduced writes do not erase needed evidence or rely on unbounded RAM.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Use physical devices well
levels.concepts: Pi/ARM images, headless boot, power, cooling, Ethernet, USB storage and sleep behaviour.
levels.guided_lab: Move the same service to a compatible Pi/spare PC, or validate portability in the stated PC route.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Diagnose an architecture, boot, USB-power or thermal issue from an authored fixture.
levels.milestone_evidence: Physical results are recorded when hardware exists; emulation is not labelled a power/thermal test.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Enforce and observe resource budgets
levels.concepts: cgroups, CPU weight/quota, memory high/max, OOM, I/O and reservations.
levels.guided_lab: Apply limits only to owned guests/cgroups and observe bounded failures.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Distinguish CPU throttling, memory pressure and slow storage.
levels.milestone_evidence: The host retains headroom and the learner accounts for every active/starting resource.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Recover connectivity and services
levels.concepts: DNS/tunnel expiry, WAN loss, credentials, restart policy and incident communication.
levels.guided_lab: Exercise a local network/credential fault, then an owned physical failure where available.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover without turning a private service into an uncontrolled public endpoint.
levels.milestone_evidence: Access and data controls still hold after recovery; downtime and remaining dependencies are stated.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Migrate without restarting the learning path
levels.concepts: SSD/RAM upgrades, separate hosts, service placement and runbooks.
levels.guided_lab: Migrate Relay and its verified state to a fresh guest or stronger device.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Handle a changed address/storage layout and validate old and new ownership.
levels.milestone_evidence: The same artifacts and evidence carry forward; a second process on one host is not called host HA.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

tracks.route: core domain offering; paths may be chosen by goal and prerequisite capability

tracks.title: Private Cloud & Platform Engineering
tracks.outcome: Operate a small college-style VM service using an existing control plane, with scoped roles and honest failure boundaries.
tracks.environment: Later track: PC lab for control-plane behaviour; spare/dedicated hosts for physical isolation and migration claims.

levels.title: Read an existing control plane
levels.concepts: libvirt/Cockpit, Proxmox, Incus and OpenStack responsibilities; VM versus cloud API.
levels.guided_lab: Trace guest creation in one supported existing platform from UI/API to hypervisor and virtual network.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain why guest SSH works without a desktop hypervisor application.
levels.milestone_evidence: Host, control-plane and guest components are mapped; vendor identity is not inferred from SSH.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Offer reproducible guest templates
levels.concepts: Images, cloud-init, identity, flavors, resource profiles and image lifecycle.
levels.guided_lab: Publish a small internal catalog of reviewed templates in the owned lab platform.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair duplicated identity or stale initialization data.
levels.milestone_evidence: Each guest has unique credentials/identity and the selected resource/network profile.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Separate learner and operator roles
levels.concepts: Projects, memberships, API identities, ownership, quotas and audit records.
levels.guided_lab: Use two sample learner identities and an operator in the local platform.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Attempt a cross-project read/resize using the wrong identity.
levels.milestone_evidence: Server-side permission checks deny the action; front-end hiding is not counted as authorization.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Handle lifecycle and resizing jobs
levels.concepts: Queued operations, states, locking, host observations, reconciliation and failed jobs.
levels.guided_lab: Create/start/stop/resize a guest and inspect the platform's job and inventory state.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a failed provisioning or partial resize operation.
levels.milestone_evidence: Requested, applied and guest-observed resources agree; reservations are retained until cleanup is confirmed.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Publish a guest service
levels.concepts: Floating/routed/bridged addresses, reverse proxy, guest perimeter and private access.
levels.guided_lab: Give a learner guest a website route and a separate administration path.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Repair a failed route without granting host administration to the guest user.
levels.milestone_evidence: Website reachability, private management and cross-guest isolation have separate controls.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Move and recover guests
levels.concepts: Backups, storage reachability, CPU compatibility, offline/live migration and physical failure domains.
levels.guided_lab: Restore or migrate between supported lab hypervisors; use a second physical host for physical-failure evidence.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Explain or recover a migration blocked by storage, CPU or network prerequisites.
levels.milestone_evidence: Guest data and identity survive; same-PC nested hosts are labelled logical migration only.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Compare orchestration layers
levels.concepts: VM lifecycle, container orchestration, Kubernetes requests/limits, scheduler and storage boundaries.
levels.guided_lab: Deploy Relay's stateless mode in a small separate cluster lab and compare its control loop with VM management.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Recover a selector/readiness or resource-allocation fault.
levels.milestone_evidence: Actual observations distinguish a process, container, guest VM and orchestration control plane.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

levels.title: Run the college-style capstone
levels.concepts: Template → assigned guest → SSH → hosted site → measured load → resize → recovery → release.
levels.guided_lab: Operate two learner guests through the selected existing control plane and hand over a reproducible runbook.
levels.independent_failure_or_transfer: Inject a failed resize, denied cross-learner operation or lost active disk.
levels.milestone_evidence: Correct ownership, resource accounting, service/data recovery and confirmed cleanup all pass.
levels.authoring_status: designed; full runnable lesson and evaluator require implementation

proof.scope: Narrow real-Caddy loopback experiment. It does not establish public/VPN/mail/VM/device capability or teaching effectiveness.

sequencing_contract.recommended_after: Advisory track order only; never interpreted as mandatory whole-track completion. Entry is based on sampled prerequisite capabilities or valid existing evidence.
sequencing_contract.suggested_after: Advisory within-track teaching order; equivalent prior evidence or practical placement can satisfy the relevant prerequisite.
sequencing_contract.production_authoring_gate: Map each executable lesson and environment variant to explicit versioned capability prerequisites before building progression rules.
